name: golang-troubleshooting
description: Troubleshoot Golang programs systematically - find and fix the root cause. Use when encountering bugs, crashes, deadlocks, races, or unexpected behavior in Go code. Covers debugging methodology, common Go pitfalls, test-driven debugging, pprof setup and capture, Delve, race detection, GODEBUG tracing, and production debugging. Start here for any 'something is wrong' situation. Not for interpreting profiles or benchmarking (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` skill), applying optimiz
author: samber
summary_zh: 调试 Go 程序的系统方法，适合排查并修复 bug、崩溃、死锁、竞态和生产环境中的异常行为。
